Question: Return agents and the policy they have sold that have had a claim and the corresponding loss reserve amount by agent id, policy number and claim number
Generated Query:
SELECT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_reserve_amount
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier IS NOT NULL
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
GROUP BY
    apr.Party_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY
    apr.Party_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number;

What is the average time to settle a claim by policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(day, c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date) AS decimal(18,2))) AS Average_Time_To_Settle_Days
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

What is the total loss of each policy by policy number where total loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amounts?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)) AS Total_Loss
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Loss_Payment lp
        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
   OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Loss_Reserve lr
        WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
   OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Expense_Payment ep
        WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
   OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Expense_Reserve er
        WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number;
